name: delegation-spans-prompt
note: THE EXCEPTION to the boundary rule, and the reason it is stated as 'the main chain blocking on input' rather than 'a prompt'. A delegated agent runs 10:00:30-10:20:00 and Craig interjects at 10:10, in the middle of it. Claude was not waiting for anybody at that instant, so 10:10 is NOT a boundary: cutting there would enter the pre-prompt piece into the survival corpus as a genuine 'Claude needed a human' observation that never happened, biasing every later forecast short. The delegated work keeps its own segment, one row, still open. The mechanical test is free — the prompt is INSIDE a union component, and a component is by definition covered by running work.
